title: Big Bus Berlin Hop on Hop off tour with optional Walking Tour
description: Say goodbye subway and hello 360-degree views when you book this hop-on, hop-off ticket on a classic open-top bus. Two great routes, with live guides or recorded commentary. Cover Berlin’s central attractions, and the app lets you track the next bus in real time. Opt for a 24-hour ticket, a 48-hour ticket with a walking tour, or a 48-hour deluxe ticket with walking tour and river cruise.

reviews.usertext: This tour was easy to book online. I walked from my hotel to the first stop which was a little over a mile. The bus was there waiting for passenger pickup. Be sure to grab some earphones as you walk onto the bus on your right. These will plug in at your seat in order to listen to the recorded information on sites along the way as well as information on each stop itself. In between there is some classical music along with what I would consider jazz. It's not unpleasant though it is repetitive. I disembarked at Museum Island as there were many great things to see at that one site. This is also where one would pick up their boat tour if that package was purchased. And also has a great currywurst stand. I got back on with very little wait time and then saw the Brandenburg gate and it's surrounding area. Most stops will have cafes in which to stop and relax and get a bite to eat or something to drink. I thought it was all handled very professionally and using the app helped time the bus arrival. The pass I purchased was good for 24 hours so I was even able to use it the following morning. I hopped off at KaDeWe.... Berlin's largest department store, which contains all major high fashion designer labels. A must see is the top floor where one can eat at the cafe or purchase boutique grocery items. The chocolate and truffle display is amazing! This tour was a great way to explore the highlights of Berlin and I highly recommend it for first time visitors.

Really enjoyed my trip to Berlin and it was made better by using this tour. The tour is broken into 2 routes, red and blue which take you across both sides of the city. While the frequency of the red line was every 10 minutes or so, the blue line only operates every hour so you can be stuck in an area if you don't watch the times. The frequency of the blue line should be increased. Also some more fun facts on the audio would be good. We took the English walking tour with our guide, Freddie and this was by far the best aspect of the tour and I would highly recommend. Freddie's local knowledge and historical knowledge are brilliant and he delivers the tour with the true style of a good story teller. Thank you to Freddie for that.

Please be aware, we paid 60 Euros at midday on Monday this week, from the blue zone, once at AlexPlatz changed to the red zone (Berlin tour), the German tour guide was excellent. We checked and the last blue zone bus was 4.40. So if you add a 2 hour tour and want to hop on and off there isn’t enough time. We ended up paying another 15 Euros for a taxi back to hotel near Osterbanhof station as by the time we had been in a museum and visited the B/Gate all the buses we had paid for were finished, so just be aware recommend start early if you want to get good value for your 60 Euros

Where do I start? They commence late and end early. For every one Big Bus there were 5 of the other competitors picking up and getting their routes done. Apart from starting at 11am (late and off schedule) from our closest stop, they also end early at 4pm. Their app routes do not match with their paper map routes that they hand you when you board. We were constantly confused as to what stop we were in. And to top it off, for every stop to drop off and pick up, the drivers would take a 10 min cigarette break. Our sightseeing was always cut short. The worst purchase ever in Berlin. Save your money and just hop on one of the other competitors.

The bus stops are not clearly labelled so it took us half a day to find one bus stop. Moreover, they are not consistent and we waited 40 minutes in the spot we were left before (asked the driver if this was the stop). We gave up and walked around to see the bus was stopped a corner and two blocks ahead. The deluxe tickets costed me €99 for me and my sister and we were not able to go to the guided tour. When we got close we are advised the Brandemburgh tour stop was undergoing reparations and that was not where the guided tour started. We asked the driver who brushed us off and we did not manage to get to the guided tour included in the package.
We were only able to really enjoy the river cruise but I saw it was only €15 if you bought it from the place…
After buying our one month €9 public transport ticket we managed to get around to all of their stops without the bus.

The concept of HOHO is great and we continue to try and continue to be a little disappointed. The “Big Bus” has a red and blue bus and they also added a green bus; you would think the timing would be better. One person said 10 minutes and it was more like 20. Then we were told 10 minutes and a bus showed up in 2. The truly maddening thing was when the driver took his breaks with a bus load, it happened to us 3 times! Just sit there while they take a 15 minutes break. There are enough buses to have a constant route going. It is also difficult to determine the stop to catch the bus unless one of the salespeople are there at the time. If all you want to do is get on and stay on, the information provided was very good. We had no trouble at all with the sound on any of the buses we rode.

A very short answer to this well-known, slightly ‘doctored’ question is: Give a thoroughly enjoyable, extremely informative talk about the Berlin Wall and its fall.

Roman was our guide for this 100 minute walking tour around some of the key sites including Brandenburg Gate, the Jewish memorial, Hitler’s bunker, Checkpoint Charlie amongst others.

His knowledge was outstanding and he presented it in an easy to access and understand way. (He was also far more patient than I would have been with two particular ‘attendees’ who wouldn’t get off their phones and kept talking!)

Well worth getting on this tour if visiting Berlin for a few days and you want a little bit more info. Make sure you get Roman… he was great!

The staff and buses were very high standard , however, we found the timing of the buses were not as we were told. One stop we had to wait half an hour for the bus. It was towards the end of the day which was worrying as the buses stop at 5pm
Annoying as often one only has so much time to complete seeing a city.
We were told there would be a bus every 10 minutes or so

We often take a Hop on Hop off tour when visiting new cities, and chose this one as it toured the sites we were interested in, but also offered a free walking tour with the 2 day pass. In the end this was the only attraction we paid for during our weekend in Berlin.
We'd booked the 2 day tour online before we left home and planned to use it as orientation and transport as I couldn't be sure how far apart the sites were.
We Walked from Brandenburg Gate down Unter Den Linden to Alexanderplatz then took the Blue tour round the East Berlin sites on the first day, with the automated audio guide on the bus. As the temperature outside was not much above freezing we were grateful of the heat on the bus.
The next day we arrived back at Brandenburg Gate for the walking tour and were welcomed by Freddie, our English guide, in a party of 12. The next 90 minutes were packed with information and entertainment, taking in the important sites and events from April 1945 up to the present day. It was just what we needed to bring the city into perspective and one of the highlights of the weekend,
Having finished the walking tour at Checkpoint Charlie, we then boarded the Red bus tour, and were joined once again by Freddie as the live guide for that route. Traffic issues caused by events in Berlin that day meant the trip took longer than usual but the entertainment continued with extra facts as we went on a slightly different route. Once again the heating on the bus was appreciated.

The 2 day pass with walking tour was great value for money, virtually no more than a 1 day pass, but we got so much more out of it.

I'm glad I took this tour on a 3 day pass because it gives you a complete overview of major attractions but the buses are very slow arriving at the locations. Beware if you do the 3 day pass with walking tour and cruise included, there will be no staff member at museum island stop 11 to direct you to where the cruise is located. I had to ask around, it was frustrating. The next day, I explained this situation to a staff member at the first stop and he wasn't really listening to me and just gave a lot of excuses. But the audio worked just fine.

Brilliant walking and bus tour. The red and blue bus tours were a great way to see a massive portion of the city. But the walking tour with Roman was an absolute highlight. He was incredibly knowledgeable and informed and went at a good pace to allow us to spend time in specific areas. Recommended!

Freddie was our guide. He provided us with a first rate tour of Berlin beginning at the Holocaust Memorial and ending at Checkpoint Charlie. We stopped at significant points where he described events from the last days of WW11 through the Berlin Wall era, and to the fall of the Wall. He related all of this fascinating information with exuberance and passion. I highly recommend this tour.

We enjoyed a short break in Berlin and decided to see the sights using the hop on hop off bus. The whole experience was good but what really made the trip worthwhile was the walking tour with Freddie.
Freddie guided us through the story of Berlin, sharing his own personal experiences, providing an insight to the history in a way that was sensitive (when it was needed) and animated (which was great entertainment!).
Fantastic guy who told the story in such a way that we will never forget.
Thanks Freddie.

The hop on hop off bus experience is always a must for me when visiting a new city. There is so much interesting information given throughout the tour that goes beyond the planned stops. I value that .
The attendants and drivers were helpful and kind. I didn’t feel I was bothering any of them with my questions in English. Communication was good. I recommend this tour to anyone who has tired feet from exploring or other tours on foot and needs a day of sightseeing combined with a little sitting when needed.

Very dissapointing experience and totally overselling. The waiting time is far to long. There is no Information available and the headphones stay silent. There are far too many tickets sold for not enough seats and busses. The busses are overcrowded. We‘ll not recommend this

A fabulous weekend with great friends was made even better by the Big Bus Tours! We booked the package of bus, river cruise and guided walking tour, which cost 40 euros each from the Rep at one of the bus stops (a bit cheaper than on-line). The tickets lasted 48 hours, which meant we had access for the Saturday and Sunday we were in Berlin.
The live guides on the buses were brilliant, especially Freddie, who we were lucky enough to also have as our walk guide.
I would fully recommend the full package- it meant we could pack all of Berlin in, in an all too short break!

"Festivals of lights' Theme of the Tour was a little misleading!!

We took this Tour on Oct 3rd, but only e few buildings were still lit, because the actual Festival ended on Sep 20th...... was not mentioned in the description of the Tour...but the Tour was still worth it.

Really disappointing was the fact that we did not get the 'Curry Wurst' during (or at the end) of the Tour like it said in the description!

Also we found it very disconcerting that the Corona Rules were none existent, the upper level of the bus was fully booked, no seat left empty, really did not like that!

I've been on Big Bus Tours in Istanbul & Dubai and I have to say that the Tours there were more enjoyable due to the fact that there were Tour Guides explaining the sights of the city, in Berlin we only had the headphones.....

All in all it was OK and we still had a good time.

I gave a 'Poor' rating because of no distancing option on the upper deck of bus during Corona.

Great way to see the City and get an overview of what is around, Really interesting commentary from both the Big Bus Co and their sister outfit (I preferred the Big Bus Co in terms of the commentary). There is a bit of waiting around at some stops, if you don't want to hop off, but not too serious. Worth getting the app so that you can see ETAs at the nearest Bus Stop to you. Well worth purchasing.

Big Bus and partner Stromma are just one of several hop on/off city tours. We did the larger route on the first day and followed up with the smaller route the following day. Got to say really enjoyed the shorter route and eastern Berlin location. Service and commentary okay. Luckily weekday so not so busy.
Overall pretty good city overview.

Many stops all around the city, the walking tour with Freddy was an absolute highlight of the Berlin experience—knows his stuff and is supremely passionate about the history. Boat ride with the Deluxe package was well worth it. Everything runs on time. Highly recommended!

We joined Freddie on his waking tour of Berlin this afternoon and it was absolutely brilliant. His knowledge and understanding of Berlin and its history brought everything to life for us. His personal antidotes of his time in Berlin just added to the show.
Freddie is a credit to the company and his walking tour is worth the ticket price alone!

I can’t speak highly enough of Big Bus - in every city me and my fiancée have been to! Berlin was the most recent trip, and on my birthday we decided to give the bus and river cruise a go. The woman on the ground was exceptionally pleasant and took the time to speak with us whilst we waited for the bus. My German was only average, but she was patient with me and really boosted my confidence in the language. And then the routes were excellent, with plenty of information in there. My partner loved the live guides, saying they were both really welcoming and informative, and they answered a few questions some passengers had - so their knowledge was more than just what was on the script. I listened to the Spanish/French audios and they were very informative too.
Simon Johnson, who was been guiding us through our experience with Big Bus, has been nothing but professional, and I would highly recommend anyone wishing to see the city to use Big Bus.

10/10!

Interesting tour that adds East Berlin to the tour for a total of 3 hrs. Despite a recorded guide it was enough along with taking in the sites. The problem we had is that one of the stops at Gendenmarkt was removed due to an event however no one on site to pass on that info. We figured it out after the bus passed without stopping and jumped on the stop before. As we passed that next stop that driver found an alternative stop nearby. On a full loop around that driver never even stopped and ignored when we asked what happened. Dropped us off 2 miles away. Disappointing how each driver decides when and where they will stop in instances such as that

Fantastic walking tour with Freddie when in Berlin, it was informative and fun with lots of facts about the city through the ages. Freddie was compelling to listen to and bought Berlin to life with his retelling of events. Very fascinating and I would highly recommend this walking tour with the hop on hop off bus option.

We booked the 2 day incl.walking tour bus ticket.
The busses arrived on time, the live tracking via the app worked pretty good too. The bus takes you to all the popular sites . The audio commentary was okay as well. Just the right amount of information in my opinion (no one can remember all these things anyways). The ground floor of the busses had airconditioning which was a blessing as it was very hot during our stay.
There wasnt much social distancing though and people did take all the seats, not leaving spaces since the busses were quite full. Might have been better to have more busses driving during these corona times.

We did the walking tour with Freddi and it was brilliant. We got a ton of interesting facts from him. He was a wonderful guide! :)

With the tickets you get a free curry wurst as well. However since we dont eat pork, there wasnt really an alternative offer. So sadly we couldnt make use of that voucher.

Overall we had a very good experience with this bus company!

Very disappointing. Very low frequency of busses, waited close to an hour for next bus at Gendarmenmarkt.

Route changed due to closed roads around Brandenburger tour, zero communication on this from company, so waited long for a bus that never came.

Additionally the sound is horrible and the gps app inaccurate.

Complete waste of money altogether.

My wife and I took this bus tour to get an overview of Berlin. The audio was terrible. When it came on it was unclear what it was referring to and it was short on interesting information more like just the name of the building. Between tour talking was loud elevator music so I turned the volume down and would miss some of the tour audio. This by far was the worst tour I have ever taken. You have been warned.

Roman was out walking tour guide and he was excellent! No question too difficult and really knew his subject. He bought the bus tour to life and made it one of the best city tours we have had. You’ll be lucky to get a better in depth tour. Recommend!

My wife, son, daughter and I bought a two-day ticket on the Big Bus in December 2019. We bought the ticket on-line which gives you a small discount. During my ten-day visit to Berlin by myself in August 2018 I had walked everywhere. But for my family and I and given that we only had three days in Berlin I think the Hop On Hop Off bus is a very good idea. There are six Hop On Hop Off bus companies in Berlin and my research indicated that the Big Bus Company was highly rated. The Red Route covers most (but not all) the key sights in Berlin. It was very convenient. We took a map and there was a commentary in English which you could listen to with earbuds provided by the Big Bus. The drivers were courteous. I prefer walking all around Berlin but if you are pressed for time in a short visit to Berlin than this is a very good idea.

we chose the 48 hour hop on hop off ticket , with the free walking tour at 1100 at the Brandenburg gate .the bus was great the guides knowledgable. we enjoyed the free walking tour as it was very interesting and not too long it visited all the areas we needed to see with a great explanation from our guide , we bought online and got the tickets prior to leaving home for about 28 pounds each.

Had a wonderful walking tour of Berlin w/ Big Bus tours this past weekend. Freddie, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable, and kept our children entertained with his theatrical performance. Tour lasted about 2hrs, starting at the Brandenburg Gates, the Holocaust memorial plaza, Hitler's bunker site, the Zipline excape over the wall, and ending at checkpoint Charlie.

Went on the bus tour (average), but great way to get around the city if you don’t want to deal with public transportation. Highlight of this review is the walking tour in English with Freddie/Freddy. He was so animated and knowledgeable about the city and its history because he lived some of it! He made our trip to Berlin memorable, and we learned so much that I forgot from US and European History.

Visited Berlin for the first time and the 3-day option provided and excellent way to structure my itinerary. The bus trips afforded me 3 options to see the city, the river cruise was good and the walking tour from the Brandenberg gate to Checkpoint Charlie was excellent. The various tour options provide excellent value for money.

The tour hits the major tourist spots and you don’t have to wait long for the bus. The first bus had a live tour guide, the second bus did not. I recommend to download the app to track buses and verify the routes. I was there Jan. 2nd and the bus had an alternate route/stops near Brandenburg Gate because it was still closed after New Years. My family and I had to get off and walk back to the stop that was skipped.
Also, there are other hop on hop off buses that run later into the night. This one stops running between 5-6pm, depending on the stop. It’s inconvenient if you want to catch dinner somewhere before heading back to wherever you are staying.

Interesting way to see the most important sights of the city. The live English-speaking guide joined the bus at Checkpoint Charlie, before that recorded commentaries in several languages were available. Unfortunately, the most important places on our tour had to be omitted as there was a demonstration taking place near thv government offices. But thanks to the live guide we were briefly informed about the sites not visited and he showed us other places not included in the original tour.

During a cold and wet few days in February there was no better way to spend our time seeing all of the best sights in Berlin, than in a modern, warm and educational Big Bus Tour bus. Strangely, as we hopped on and off during our two day pass we kept meeting with the same live tour guide. He made the journey, which was quite expansive, much more fun and enjoyable. Adding his own personality, humour and knowledge along the way - I didn't get his name but he was the tall, dark haired man with the bottled water and carrot sticks. This was one of the better rated companies to use in Berlin and I'm glad I chose the Big Bus Tour. My only criticism would be that sometimes, if I didn't have the app, I would struggle to find the pick up and drop off points. There didn't seem to be any obvious signage at certain points, at least the ones not manned by staff in branded coats. But I believe this to be the same for all of the various bus tours, so maybe a restriction set by the local Government?

Great tour option for family travel. I have my 10-yr-old son with me.
Totally worth it!

The only thing is the length of time it takes to complete, if you have limited time, choose which attractions you'd like to visit and get off the bus at the stop, then back on to see other attractions on the bus - if you can get the front seats it would be ideal!

We used the bus tour (2 hours) on a drive-by stop-over just to get some basic impressions and had the luck of a sunny winter afternoon. The ticket is valid for 24 hours of which we only used two as we had to continue our journey. Nevertheless we felt well informed, saw much more than if we had tried to do the same route on our own. The bus well heated, not overcrowded, the live guide (present on 2/3 of our route) provided valuable information and hints for further exploring. It can be worth while to ask for discounts when entering the bus.

We are very dissapointed by this tour. Buses do not come regurally and they follow different route as they have assigned. We have been waiting in stop 10 for 45 minutes and we have up. We used this bus only for 10 stops and after long waiting time with 3 year old we decided to leave. We recomend to choose their competition as busses came much more frequent from all other providers

Along with the bus tour, we also did the walking tour with our guide, Freddie. Freddie was very knowledgable and friendly. He added so much information to the bus tour, making it much more personal. He is a natural born story-teller! The tour last just over the 90 minutes suggested and gave us an excellent insight into the last days of nazi rule. I would highly recommend doing the walking tour after the bus tour as it adds so much more.

Really good value bus tour, river cruise and walking tour. Two bus routes to go on. I brought a 72hr bus ticket, which included the waking tour, river cruise and bratwurst. It is a great value package and you will need at least 48hrs to do it all. The walking tour - Freddie was great and told us lots and put lots of effort into the tour. Thank-you! Highly recommended!

We did the red route bus tour and booked online in advance, which meant we got a small discount. Instructions online about routes and pick up points were very clear and accessible. We had a live guide, Thomas, who was outstanding - both extremely knowledgable and very personable. One of the highlights of our trip to Berlin and we hope to return very soon!

English speaking walking tour 31 Mar 2022, Freddie / Freddy was absolutely brilliant, he’s from London and has lived in Berlin since 1979.

Very knowledgeable, answered all our questions, really excellent tour, thank you very much, we found it really interesting and I particularly enjoyed the story at the end when the Berlin Wall checkpoints were finally opened.

I can thoroughly recommend the walking tour with Freddy, it’s worth the extra money to have this - he’s a credit to your company. Thanks again.

Always go on a bus tour in major cities but this one didn't do as well as others. There is no indication as to where the bus actually stops and you are reliant on the app of the staff there, but the app is often terrible as its not been updated to compensate for roadworks and some buses arent even tracked on it. Also the first bus I got on was from a separate company so to actually get my paper ticket for the extras I had to get off at a stop to get it.

We liked this option to help us get to the main attractions in the city quickly and with a tour of what we were seeing. You can use it all day to get to the best spots quickly as well. Great first day option to get acquainted.

Buses don't show up, you can't call the tour company-it rings a few times and disconnects, app only partially works, no signs anywhere to guide you. Tour company did not respond to Trip Advisor when they tried to investigate. My precious vacation time was wasted waiting for phantom buses to come and a phantom walking tour! Horrible experience.

We loved the walking tour even more than the bus tour. The bus tour just gave prerecorded general info about what we were passing by.

The walking tour, however, was amazing. Freddy was our guide. He was a resident of Berlin and lived through the building and tearing down of the Berlin Wall. He was very knowledgeable and gave us the backstory on everything. He was passionate and funny. Even my 8 and 10 year old were interested in learning about Berlin's history.

I had enjoyed my two day ticket with the walking tour and river cruise, unfortunately after taking the last river cruise for the day, the bus did not make a full circuit so that I could get back to the stop closet to my hotel. Instead I was dumped at stop 1, a 20 euro taxi ride away from my hotel (which was a 10 min walk from one of the stops). I am disappointed that you can’t coordinate your services with the services of the River Cruise. A disappointing end to an otherwise good day.

Excellent and comprehensive tour on the bus, as you can get a global view of the city in a short time. Very interesting the recorded comments during the tour.
5 stars to the walking tour as well. Roman, the guide that hosted us, was very knowledgeable and also added a few personal comments, being himself a Berliner.

Fantastic open bus tour. Great audio that is informative and you can also use the green bus company so buses available regularly. We did the history walk with Freddy - he was a fabulous and engaging speaker. Our kids (aged 9 & 12) were enthralled with his stories to tell history and explain significant events and places. We would not have learned so much about Berlin’s pre/post war history and the Berlin wall without Freddy’s expertise and lived experience as a Berlin resident before and after the wall came down. Highly recommended.

I always do a big bus tour when I arrive in any company.

This one in Berlin was a good route I think. The drivers were all polite and the live English commentary was really good and a nice touch actually and the first time I have come across this. And these were the warmest tour buses every experienced it was great. I also liked the fact the 48 hour ticket had a mix of the to do i.e walking tour, river cruise. We enjoyed the river cruise.

The two downfalls was it felt that the big bus was running less buses than the other possibly 4 tour companies as several of each would come before one big bus. Also I think the hours 9:30 - 4:30pm didn't give you enough time to use tickets to the maximum.

The walking tour was impossible to do because of a demonstration near the Brandenburger Gate , so Freddy, our guide, offered us an alternative option and guided us through the story of berlin. We really appreciated it and it was so awesome listening to his knowledge about the historical facts of berlin and national socialism. Thank you Freddy!!

Takes you all over the city, great stories and well marked stops. Also ticket person at the major stops so you dont have to buy online. Because of the length of the tour if you stay on for the full tour its hard to go back and do the hop on hop off part but it gives you a great idea of what you do want to see so you can go back on your own.

Our tour guide Freddie, captivated us with a 90 minute yarn / walking tour today.
My son Om is easily bored and usually tunes out but this time to our surprise and delight we witnessed a new side to him - he hung on every word and followed Freddie around as we moved through the various points of the tour.
We couldn't complete the entire circuit on the bus but we still had an awesome time - thank you Freddie !

Bus stops way too early. At 16:00 the last one leaves and at Alexandplatz you are ‘stuck’ at 17:45 already. This is not announced when you get your tickets and it’s in very little writing on the map you provide. For a tourist your day doesn’t end at this hour.

Short break in Berlin and booked a two day tour which included the walking tour.
Narrative on bus very informative via headphones in language of your choice.
Walking tour with Freddie absolutely superb. He was knowledgeable, funny and brought history to life. I could have listened to him all day. Well worth the money for this tour alone.
Only negative we seemed to wait for ages fir a bus. I was under the impression they were every 30 mins but didn’t seem to be., however we still had a fantastic time and will be back soon as there is so much to do.

We had the chance to be with this great Australian Guide, Chris.. he presented the city in a verry interesting way, has a lot of information to share. If you get there don't miss the chance to assist to his walk tour!
Kudos Chris for the nice work!

The ride and drivers were fine, but the recorded commentary was HORRIBLE. Not only was it super cheesy, but it didn’t tell us much. There was LOTS of blank moments when they could have been telling us some more history or telling us about more of the buildings. I’d try a different tour.

Good value for money and a great way to see the city and get your bearings if you are on a short break as we were. Our guide on the bus had an excellent knowledge of all the historical buildings and history of Berlin.
Our only criticism would be that it was difficult to find the bus stops despite using the app.

Did the walking tour with Chris. Very knowledgeable and informative. Continued with the red route on a bus with a live guide, Roman. It was great hearing from a local himself. Overall, staff at the Big Bus Berlin were very helpful and courteous. Just note that not all the buses have a live guide. I think it is written on the bus sign on the front of the bus ‘live guide’ if there is one. Otherwise, the recorded audio is pretty ok. But I much prefer a live guide. Keep up the good work Big Bus team.

We took the big bus with my friend and Salvador, a man who sell the ticket, gave us for free because i lost mine. He was very nice and i'm really thankfull. The help of the people at the stop at alexanderplatzt is very complete and helpfull. I will recommand anyone to go to the big bus tour, green tour. Thank you again

What a fabulous tour - the bus tour was great and the walking tour with Freddie was just brilliant. What an informative and fun tour that was. I had a great time and learnt so much about the city and it’s fascinating part,

Freddie was absolutely brilliant. His easy manner brought history alive. I really enjoyed the tour and all the significant spots featured. The voices the excerpts from history were funny and engaging. When I go again to Berlin I will definitely be booking on to the tour again to hopefully hear it all again.
Thanks you so much for putting so much enthusiasm amd heart into the 'show'.
Fab. From fran from watford.

The bus was great. The walking tour with Freddie was phenomenal! Freddie was engaging and very informative. He obviously was extremely passionate and he made the history very interesting. An absolute must if you’re coming to Berlin. Hopefully you’ll get Freddie.

Found it looking through other Google reviews - it is the only 5 star place in the neighbourhood.
Previous reviews are absolutely right. Pizza was really tasty. Service was extremely quick. We were in a rush, and got our food very fast.
My little one wants to visit the place again. My husband is jealous we had such a good pizza.

We went to Berlin in July. Probably on the hottest days of the year. Despite that, we had a great walking tour from tour guide Freddy. He made our holiday with his wonderful stories. That is why we definitely recommend him if you have the time for it.

Had a great time with Bug Bus Berlin!!! Had an amazing tour guide called Natasha from the UK. She was well informed, knew her history but was fun and bubbly. A great trip around Berlin was made better and more entertaining with her. 5 stars would recommend!!!!

Great way to see the sites of Berlin, both the electronic and tour guides commentaries were very helpful. The weather was very wet and cold so the bus was a great option and we were able to choose which of the sites to visit again the next day on foot.

The bus is a great way to see the city. My partner and I did the 48-hr tour.

However, on the walking tour the guide (a Danish girl) was very opinionated, particularly on British politics. Having just had an election over here in the UK, she had a LOT to say about the results the very next morning when we arrived for our tour and she discovered we were English making things very awkward!!

My partner and I felt she also made quite a few ‘digs’ at British people and was very opinionated on where the government should be spending its money...completely irrelevant to the tour!! Might I suggest she sticks to the agenda??

It may also be worth someone telling her that just because she spent 2 years studying in the UK does not qualify her to trash talk the country and it’s people, many of whom were on the ENGLISH tour!!!

I noticed there is also another review on here saying the same thing about her!!

Read up about this and planned to get the live english speaking guide - on the red route. When we jumped on it was just the prerecorded audio tour option with earphones. Was a bit disappointed as we chose this for the live guide - Bus driver was great.

We 've been in Berlin 3 times for a city break and use this company all the time we re
About to book again now lockdown is nearly lifted in Britain . Looking forward to seeing all the lovely Berliners .

Fantastic experience with 6 choices of languages. We were very happy with the routes and the ability to hop on at any location indicated on their map. Also a great way and affordable way to get arround downtown.
The tour was very good I only have 2 complaints. The bus was very uncomfortable because the seats are made out of straight plastic. The last complaint I have was the live tour was very opinionated.

Bought the 2 day pass which included a 90 minute walking tour, worth every penny, bus guide was superb,drivers were very helpful and walking guide so knowledgable. Best way tsee Berlin and decide where we wanted to go ourselves for other days.

I love the big bus tours - we did the one in Budapest and loved it so when I saw they did one in Berlin we booked straight onto it, we did the 48 hour with both the red and blue lines - such a great way to see the city we jump off at most stops have a look around and then jump back on!! Love that there are live tour guides on the bus - we had a couple as we kept jumping on and off and everyone of them had interesting facts and really knew what they were talking about! I highly recommend doing the big bus tour!!
We booked the 48hrs deluxe ticket tour that includes the river tour, but nowhere was mentioning that river cruises are not operating on Mondays-Wednesdays.

We boarded the tour @ Checkpoint Charlie on a rainy Saturday (14/12/2019) to try & stay dry.As we boarded, so did a guide who was going to go live. Chris was his name & he is Australian. As an approved tour guide here in Dublin, i really appreciated his knowledge of both Berlin & the story of the city. He made our tour very enjoyable.

Easy to use and informative. The buses were clean and comfortable. The live guides were entertaining and gave some good insights into the locations and Berlin in general. Really useful to have a look around and decided where you want to explore more. €30 for 2 day ticket is good value. Lots of hop on and off companies but this looked most professional. Saw lots of the city in just a few hours.

We took the walking tour on Friday 13th and it was absolutely fantastic! The route includes everything that you need to see in Berlin, we particularly loved Brandenburger Tor and seeing part of the Berlin wall as it was our first time in the city.

However, what really made our day was our fantastic tour guide Nanna, I think she was Danish. Not only did she provide informative and engaging information about the city and landmarks but she eloquently connected it to contemporary European politics. This was particularly pertinent with regards the previous day's general election in our country, the UK. She drew on her own time in England and connected it to the history and politics of Berlin, Germany, and Europe as a whole. This is exactly what a tour should be; not just a sterile retelling of the facts and dates of a history of the city but the act of making that history come to life and relating it to our contemporary social world.

Absolutely fantastic and would reccomend to anyone that wants a tour which really relates the past to the present and our future.

Very good Hoho bus service, had 4 different live guides, all were good and very knowledgeable. A good way of getting to see the main sights of Berlin.
Would recommend.

The buses are really warm, so it’s really nice on winter. The guide, Patrizia, was very good, she added facts about the countries that we told ver we came from! Really easy to understand for non native english speakers 🤗🤗

The bus tour was great don’t get me wrong. My issue was finding out that their promise that it was cheaper to buy online was a lie. I purchased online then was told by a street vendor that if I bought from him I would of got the ticket for 27€ rather than the 31€ online. This wouldn’t usually annoy me, however the website says you get 10% off ALL tickets when you purchase online. I have an issue with false and misleading statements by businesses. So I emailed the company and the customer service person tried to tell me the street vendor was referring to the one day ticket. Okay plausible story, however I was travelling with my sister who wasn’t there the first day I went on the bus. We tested the street vendors the next day and she bought her two day ticket for 27€! All I want is a refund of 7€ to make their false and misleading website actually true! It has taken about 1 week to get a response from the representative through email. I’m just sick of being ripped off!

We were only in Berlin for a couple of days so this was a no-brainer. While it's not cheap, around 25 euros, it allowed us to get around quickly to all of the best sites. Considering the public transport costs add up if you get around yourself, this really was worth the cost!

Total waste of time and money cost €50 and that was with discount for a day pass on the bus.
Absolute waste of money you can do everything that you need to do and visit by using public transport the day after using the bus we went to Brandenburg gate Reichstag
All using public transport and with no hassle at all
all the places that the buses visit or drop you off at you can quite easily get to using public transport if you have a decent mobile phone with Google Maps it tells you the time of the bus ithe times of trains the underground times everything that you need to know to get to where you want to go
if you want to save yourself some money just use public transport like I say buses are a waste of money

We got on the first bus of the day, a big red bus, and the driver waved us on because there was no ticket checker yet. Turned out we were on the wrong bus line when we got off 8 stops later, and boy were we glad to find that out! The actual Big Bus Berlin Hop Off Hop On was much more comfortable and the audio guide clearer and more entertaining. Our family did Hop On Hop Off over 2 days and the Big Bus Berlin even had a bus with a live tour guide. That was a very special treat as people could ask him questions. We would definitely recommend the Big Bus Berlin.The high view over so many sections of the city and the tour information were great.

Once you find the bus and get on the tour is very good. We saw parts of the city we possibly wouldn’t otherwise have seen. The on board guides were friendly and very well informed about the history and various sites visited. This was mostly in a humorous manner rather than didactic. The ear pieces provided gave good clear sound quality.
The improvements need to be made on locating the bus in the first place! It’s very difficult to work out the route and hop on/off points from a city map. Once on board they give you a route map that is invaluable. Please give the map as a PDF with the confirmed booking, lots of time and anxiety would be avoided!
If you can find the bus, highly recommend the tour, with the bonus of using it to travel around the city as a hop on/off option.

There are lots of hop on hop off bus tours in Berlin but I was really disappointed when I read the poor reviews. We eventually decided on the Big Bus as it is new (only been a few months in Berlin) and new buses would mean the headphones would be working (went on City Sightseeing previously and so many of their headphone ports were broken).
Really glad we made the right decision as the Big Bus company was excellent. Most of their buses have live commentary and the two guides we had did a great job. There were protests in the city so a small detour was needed but due to their being actual guides they were able to adapt no problem (which a recorded commentary wouldn't have managed). Buses were clean and we always managed to get good seats upstairs without any problem. We never had to wait long for a bus and were able to use their app to see exactly where the next bus was which was great.
We bought the two day ticket which was only 5 euros more so definitely worth it. This covered two routes which enabled us to see the whole city, plus a walking tour. The walking tour was fantastic. We had a young Australian man called Chris who was very knowledgable about German history and showed a genuine interest (not just reciting a script). He did brilliantly to manage a diverse group of nationalities, ages and characters. I'd definitely recommend doing both the bus and walking tours as the bus gives a good general overview followed by a more personal detailed expereince on the walking tour. The walking tour is only 90 minutes but we were able to return to the places we were most interested in to spend some more time later.
Only one tip for the guides - please remember it is 'Britain/British' not 'England/English' (England is only one part of Britain). This mistake might not seem important but when talking about WW2 it definitely is.

Chose this company because of supposed live guides. The two times we took the Big Bus there was no guide. In addition the audio on the headphones was extremely poor both in that the English was not good and the commentary was very dry and not to informative.

this tour was plesant suprise. we took deluxe ticket. first day we had an issue, there were some demonstrations and we couldn see center of berlin. river cruise tour is great and red line and blue lines are very good. there are wnoug buses which cover all berlin. at the blue line, holzmarkt as hit spot in berlin should be established as bus station. eastern railway station is 5 - 10 walk on foot from railway station. big bus is not so popular in berlin, i think they are new in berlin but they are very good. highly recommendable bus tour
Very nice buss driver. Very engaged in his job and it really reflected on our experience. Way to go!

We were very disappointed with this service today. We hopped on one of the first buses at 10am and had a pretty good round trip on line one. Lots of long waits at some stops but I guess we expected that. Swapped to line 2 and got off at stop 3 for a walk and some lunch. Back at the bus stop an hour later, and waited for more than an hour until one of the bus drivers on one of the other many hop on hop off bus lines told us our company had shut up shop for the day and gone home. No more buses and we’d been waiting since 1.30 pm! Apparently the police had closed some roads in the city but we’d already gotten past that earlier and all the other buses were still operating their services on the same route! We paid for a full day riding on the buses and got 3 hours before we were stranded miles from where we started. Very very poor service

This was a disappointing experience, maybe better described at an attempt at bait-and-switch. We booked the bus tour with walking tour and checked in at Alexanderplatz; they told us that our voucher from Viator only covered the bus tour, not the walking tour. So we fumed quietly, boarded the bus and resolved to sort it out with the walking tour guide.
He turned out to be willing to do the right thing, so we got our tour; he was fun to listen to. Freddie described himself as a Brit who arrived with the Army and decided to stay; we thought he arrived with a theatre company and decided to stay. He took us to the key sights within walking distance of the Brandenberg Tor and regaled us with wonderfully theatrical performances at many of the stops. We’ll remember our time in Berlin vividly, but no thanks to Viator.

No bus showed up for over an hours.

No responses on the chat and no other way to contact them for a refund. At least 10 annoyed passengers taking other buses.
Good bus tour English commentary perfectly clear. But anyone who buys a ticket should also do the walking tour with Freddie which was enjoyable and informative
Freddy took us on our walking tour. He was very informative and funny. Didn't walk to fast and waited while we took photos. A thoroughly enjoyable experience. Freddy was great

We went for the deluxe ticket which includes a 48 hour bus ticket, a walking tour and river trip. Since we bought the tickets online via TripAdvisor in advance we made a good saving on the price. This tour is excellent and really made our trip, especially as our 'live' guide, Nana, was really informative and entertaining. I would recommend checking the times for the walking tour and boat trips on the local Berlin website so you don't miss out; it's worth the forward planning. In summary a great experience!

Disappointing experience. I paid extra to get a 48 hour pass with river cruise. When I got to the river cruise pier, Found out that the cruise doesn’t operate from Monday to Wednesday - and I bought the ticket for tue and Wednesday and TripAdvisor sold it to me after ‘checking availability’ so to speak. They should have known upfront. I feel cheated out of money on this and demand a refund for the river cruise.

Really had a great time, always ask
for CHRIS as guide he's doing an amazing job!
Never had to wait long. Busses were clean and warm. Drivers, salesmen and guides are really friendly.

Having a live guide rather than a recording is so much more informative and interesting. The guides add in extra details and answer questions along the way. The 2 routes are very different in length and the shorter blue route had a recorded guide when we took it. But that was fine. It was cold in Berlin but the upper deck of the buses were very warm. We used our tickets Friday afternoon and Saturday morning which worked very well and gave us a good idea of what to return to during the rest of our stay. Highly recommend the tour.

I would recommend Big Bus to anyone visiting Berlin. We purchased a 24 hour ticket and loved that your time started based on first time on the bus. So we got on for the first time in the afternoon and had until 24 hours the next day to use the bus. We had 3 different English speaking live tour guides and all were very good and gave lots of good information. Big Bus is new to Berlin so buses were never crowded. Everyone was very friendly, helpful, and professional. We were amazed at how the driver navigated through the crowded narrow streets. I also recommend downloading the Big Bus app so you can see where the buses are and how far they are from the different stops so you can time it so you're not waiting a long time for a bus.

found the route good for the major sites.
good live info, on several of the buses that I took.
Excellent walking tour with nanna, really knows her history!
Would recommend the Big Bus.

Can highly recommend the Premium Tour tickets which includes a 90 minute walking tour. Australian Chris our guide was very passionate and knowledgeable of the history of Berlin - really enjoyable tour. The live guides on the bus were also very knowledgeable!

Frm the drivers, the English guide (Freddie) to the staff at each stop, they were all very helpful & friendly. The schedules of bus arrivals were also great, we never had to wait long. Freddie, our English guide was so informative.
We highly recommend this company to anyone who is looking for a "hop-on hop-off" company.

Having never been to Berlin before we thought this would be a great way of negotiating the city. We did have a bit of difficulty in finding stop 1 red route as even though we had checked the map, it wasn’t definitive/small enough to show where the exact pick up point was.
We eventually found stop 2 outside KaDeWe where we jumped on. We had a German gentlemen to start with who we sat next to to listen to his commentary until we got off a few stops later.
When we reboarded at stop 7, where our new guide was Chris, a young Australian guy. He was so super informative, entertaining and engaging. I don’t know how he manages to remember all of the hundreds of facts and figures he had to deliver, but at no point did we feel he was fluffing his way through and mis-informing us. I learnt so much about the history of Berlin, pre wars as well as obviously during the Cold War and post wall era. Really good value for money. Highly recommended.

Sadly we were only in Berlin for 30 hours staying 2 nights and it was a surprise trip my partner booked at the last minute. Late Saturday evening after a quick look at information on and reviews of hop on hop off buses and we booked Big Bus online. We weren’t disappointed. The app was excellent at showing us the nearest bus stop to our hotel to start the red route. The buses were all very clean and the live tour guides very knowledgable. We will definitely use again as so much more to more to see in Berlin. Also would definitely use ‘Big Bus’ in other cities too.

Being a well trodden tourist with 40 years experience Big Red Bus was my polar opposite of my idea of gong out a new city.

However, I have aged and I wanted to get around and see all the must sees....

We did and my fears were alleviated. It was great and having done the trip on the bus we had wasted no time and were able to then go back and see what we liked.

Not for a backpacker. But good for a “retired but wanna be backpacker!”
The live tour guide changed Berlin for us .... we could ask questions and there were even spontaneous conversation with other bus hoppers.

We went for the deluxe tour. The walking tour was absolutely fantastic. Our guide Chris was amazing, so knowledgeable and interesting. Just the right tone.

The bus tours were also good, really good to get a view of the city and be able to see from above.

The boat tour was not as good, seeing the city from the river was lovely. But the ‘extras’ felt like a bit of a ripoff. We ordered two waters and were charged over €7! Which was nuts.

Overall though, we really enjoyed it and would definitely recommend.
Great wall to see the overview and hightlights of Berlin. it is a hop on hop off. Two seperate tours and we took both. So much histrory

We booked our Hop on Hop off tour in Berlin because we have used them in many other cities and found them to provide quality tours. They are new to Berlin, but provided the same top quality tour that we have come to expect.

I looked at a lot of reviews before settling on big bus and I can’t compare but this was a great company. It was easy to book online. Buses were regular. Every host was knowledgeable. Some funnier than others but all good. I’d recommend this tour as a great way to spot the landmarks in Berlin. Even in the rain and on a public holiday

We wanted to see see Berlin after running the marathon the day before. This was perfect buses were all in good condition and regular, guides were all very knowledgeable, the app was useful to track location of bus to make decisions when to hop back on . Great

all good - the live guides were great - especially Eric and I understand that other tour buses don't have live guides now

Great value and I can recommend to all

After previously using Big Bus Tours in both Paris and San Francisco, again we have used Big Bus Tours this time in Berlin which failed to disappoint!! We booked the Deluxe 2 day ticket which included the bus for 48 hours, river cruise on the River Spree and 90 minute walking tour. We’d really like to commend our walking tour guide Freddie who’s natural charm and insightful commentary we thoroughly enjoyed! The bus has commentary in multiple languages but a live guide is provided also...
We hope to be on a Big Bus again soon!!

The ticket sellers on the side of the roads are lovely along with the bus drivers that we had. Only downfall was one bus driver drove past us waiting by east side gallery. We then had to lug or luggage in 28° heat to the next stop and wait for the next bus...this came but wasnt in use...had to wait for the next bus!!!
Also the problem is alot of their buses stop at certain stops at 4.30 or 5.30pm....this is too early when most places you want to visit are too far away to walk to. We had to catch the train a few times as the buses had stopped before we finished site seeing.
Also need to give a massive shout out to our live commentator on the bus...Ronan or Roman. He was lovely and threw in a few funny facts. Would recommend the bus company just on him. It's a shame that the 1 bus driver and the time cut off has lowered my opinion and my score.

The price is included in the Berlin Pass otherwise it is €25 which is a bit steep as you can get a daily travel card for €7. That aside there are distinct advantages to using the Big Bus Tours; the main one being the open top which is great and makes a big difference from the standard busses and the other big advantage is the commentary which I found excellent. We used the bus on day one and learned so much about the city, much of which isn’t in the guide books and much of which you identify with the actual buildings that are being described.
Hopping on and off is fun and the busses are frequent.
Getting a ticket with a Berlin Pass takes time especially if you are travelling with friends so give yourself time before you catch the bus.
Would we have bought a ticket if we hadn’t had the Berlin Pass? Probably not because of the price, but don’t let that put you off as we did enjoy it.
The photos were taken from the bus.

Had a day in Berlin so decided to book Big Bus tour. Went passed all the sights we wanted to see on the Red Tour route. Great commentary provided by our guide Freddy who has lived in Berlin for 40 years. Great insight into Berlin, as it is today and from an historical perspective. Recommended.

I purchased my ticket online in the morning and then visited a stop to redeem on the same day. When I got off the bus I misplaced my small paper ticket, when I tried to get another copy of the paper ticket I was told that I had to buy a whole new ticket because the small paper ticket was necessary despite me having proof of purchase from that morning and when they scanned they could see that I had redeemed already (e.g wasn’t trying to use for a second day). Why offer online option if you have to keep a tiny piece of paper that cannot be replaced?
There are more than three hop on, hop off buses offering the same route - don’t use this one.

This tour does what it says...give you a tour of Berlin. Booked via app. Easy. Young guide on the street by Potsdamer Platz very friendly. Bus driver friendly. Took in the whole tour. Saw all the landmarks of Berlin. Was a good tour from that perspective. The tour guide (young danish girl) was very knowledgable and informative. However, like most millennials today, she was also very opinionated and should learn to keep some of these to herself as we are on a tour not a political agenda! We were not wanting to learn her opinion on the ‘privileged white man and how they sexually assault women’’ or on how ‘being gay is not a choice it is how you are born’ or on how zoos are ‘animal prisons’ to name but a few. Maybe she needs to reign in her views because we didn’t need to hear them! Some of these views are her assumptions and not based on fact. In our line of work, there are plenty of different men from many ethnic backgrounds who sexually assault women. She also seemed very keen to finish her shift after 6 hours of talking...But the actual tour was good and we got to see areas of Berlin that we hadn’t walked to.

It was my first time in Berlin and I got to explore the city in a heated bus (which I am so very thankful for). I am also so glad when I booked I booked with the walking tour option. Freddie, our guide was just the best. He took us to the sites and explained the historical significance to us. A lot of the history, I must say, was pretty heavy stuff, but Freddie was both informative and entertaining. The walking tour was the best part my weekend solo-ing the beautiful city.
We road the bus and decided to do the 2pm walking tour with Freddie and he was amazing!!! Best tour guide I’ve ever had, he was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic!
Freddie’s walking tour is a must! He has outstanding knowledge and enthusiasm for the history of Berlin having lived it himself and really brings it to life. Couldn’t recommend enough
Freddie on the walking tour was fantastic, the time flew by and any questions I had didn’t need to be asked, he was though, clear and a good laugh, would definitely recommend.

The bus tour really informative, had a 2 day ticket so took the walking tour on day 2. Our guide Freddie was fantastic, really brought history to life with real experience of what happened during Berlín at the time of the wall. Would definitely recommend.
It was ok like any other bus tour. No real complaints but nothing huge happened either. It enabled us to get around cheaper than a taxi or Uber.

Love the idea of hop on and hop off buses but finding the pick up and drop off points was more luck than judgement.
Great way to see all the sites in one day though
Recommend the restaurant on the left by the Mercedes’ arena near the east side gallery
Very nice good and people

The walking tour with Freddie was excellent. He should have been an actor
He has some great anecdotes, told in an interesting way
It was nice to get background on what we were seeing and have the option to get off and explore areas of interest. We chose the three day option and it was worth it.

Worth every cent. Covers most of the city with interesting information. Not as cheap as the local buses - as they are free at the moment but you will not get the background and chance to take plenty of photos

We booked Big bus but ended with Stromma.de tickets. Big bus loaded us with the bar code we got via e-mail. So far so good.

Then after getting off at Alexanderplatz and walking, the, stop at the palace was closed. We walked all the way back to Alexanderplats and then had to get a new receipt to get on a Stromma.de bus. Waited 15min before departure. Then another 10min stop at Brandenburg bridge, 13 minutes wait at Berlin main station, and by the time we got to Victory tower, the driver needed another 15 break.

We sat in +34C, one of Berlin warmest days, this year!! When we wanted to close the rooftop, the driver freaked out. We got off asking why we are stopping so long at every stop... but got into a verbal abusive dialogue initiated by the driver.

We hopped off and booked four TIER scooters and rode to our hotel. Even worked out cheaper.

Probably not the fault of Big Bus... but if their partners let us on they should set the standards. Strange thing is that we booked via Big Bus but got Stromma.de tickets... and stromma.de driver was the worst. Maybe I got the booking/operators mixed up... but all we wanted was a simple hop on/hop off tour... not on the "drivers conditions"

Contact me if I am am wrong.
The worst experience ever. It took forever for the bus to come and get ppl from the east side gallery. They are good at leaving their customers stranded. Avoid at all cost@@@

The worst experience, customer service sucks
Busses late stuff are horrible and long waiting time till the busses start driving from some points
Very useful. The tour is perfect for enjoying your visit. They drivers are very helpful. The river cruise was beautiful.
Excellent way to see all of the sights in the City. We did this on our first day and it was great to get your bearings. Audio was very interesting and had a choice of 2 different bus companies.
Good value tour covering old East and West Berlin. Interesting cruise but highlight was walking tour with Freddie - 5* experience and learnt so much in an interesting way.

Great way to see Berlin, really enjoyed the bus and the opportunity to hop off to see the sites at around 20 different places. We chose this for our first day and it gave us a great orientation of the city.
I have booked a bus with walking tour, but we were just sitting all the time. The audio was informative.
nice tour of the principal atractions. Able to visit and take the next bus. Good explanation of the sites
The walk filled in a lot of gaps in my understanding German history. Freddie was entertaining and very approachable. Thanks for an informative walk.

5 star !!!
Freddie was amazing! Obviously knows his Berlin history and tells it with so much passion. Really enjoyed the walking tour and learned so much!!
Highly recommend!!
Just finished our walking tour with Freddie. We absolutely loved it. His knowledge and enthusiasm as well as his personal experience has made our trip. Thank you.
Walking tour was very good. Freddy - full marks for knowledge, he was there when the wall fell. We bought 2 day ticket. Worth the money
Really great way to see all the attractions.Highly recommend! Super staff, great busses, good prices

What amazing value for money!

Great service and all the free add ones were brilliant!

The only downfall was the online bus tracking wasn’t available.

Another plus point was the buses had usb plugs so you could charge your phone whilst taking in all the views!!
Freddy. Freddy. Freddy. You have to go with Freddy. He is the best tour guide i’ve had. Very passionate. Great stories, keeps you on your toes. Enjoyed the whole thing!

Great walking tour with our guide Freddy! He provided very interesting information understandable also for foreign tourist with a basic understanding of English. Also his enthousiasme made it very enjoyable! Would recommend the walking tour strongly!

Once we were on the bus, some of our party had problems with their audio syncing up to what we were actually looking at.

We were told a bus would be by every 30 minutes. On two occasions, our group waited for more than an hour for the next bus. One group ended up taking an Uber and then missed part of the tour.

The tickets were easy to redeem from the staff member where we waited for the bus in front of Checkpoint Charlie. The gal was very friendly and helpful but it went downhill from there.
The tour guide for the big bus hop hop off walking tour - Freddy - is amazing. Very knowledgeable, friendly, engaging and overall delivered a superb experience. Strongly recommended.
Clean, convenient and courteous! Great company with great service. Trust Big Bus Tours to take you where you need to go.

Kelly and Chenai were the absolute best trip sellers I've ever come across

Absolute legends! Sent us to the pub and to the sights

Brilliant!!!!!!! 😅
Fantastic way to see the city. Nanna (our guide) was extremely friendly, knowledgable and courteous. Highly recommended.

Caught the 3rd to the last bus to return to our starting point. The driver took us part way there and told us he was at the end of his route and another bus would pick us up in 10 minutes. Over 20 people got off to catch next bus. Next bus pulse up and kicks 15 people off. 35 people stranded by this company. Not a good experience. Use the other Hop and Go.

Really good service
The drivers are helpful, the routes as cover everything you want to see. The bus is comfortable, the earphones work. It was good value for money, cheaper when booked online. We did not wait any longer than 15 mins for a bus. Highly recommended

Booked on line all very easy. Great service found the staff very helpful and informative. It was a great way to see Berlin in our short time there and enabled us to revisit areas of interest. recommended

It was a rainy day in Berlin when we took the big bus tour. After we figured out how to validate our tickets, things went smoothly. My husband was in a wheelchair and since it was raining, we toured Berlin from the bus, not hopping on and off. We had a live guide that was very informative and made our tour very enjoyable.

We had planned on taking another hop- on-hop-off tour bus but we're so pleased we opted for Big Bus Berlin - it would have to have been the best Hop On Hop Off tours we've experienced in many years of international travel. Our first positive encounter was with staff member Gemma - a lovely young lady who was helpful, friendly and professional- then came the very interesting live commentary -in English - by Martin, and overall we had a driver whose skills meant our journey was comfortable and enjoyable. Thanks, Gemma for putting us on the bus and welcoming us back at the end of the tour - your personal effort deserves a thumbs up.

Had a two day pass for the Big Bus Berlin Hop on Hop off tour with guide which included the walking tour. Found this to be the best way to see the city. our vist to Berlin was primarly for the christmas markets which were good but some were overcrowded, could hardly move about.

There was no live guide but everyone was
Very nice & worked well for me. Except one of the guys said the boat left every half hour & he was totally wrong. It was the schedule written down so I wasted an hour waiting.
Sadly, we saw lots of buses in Berlin, but not many Big Buses. However, the walking tour was excellent and our guide Ricardo was both informative and enthusiastic

We visited Berlin on November 28th 2019 and after all good reviews took a tour. Bus was great and really warm but we couldn’t understand a word the guide said as he was very hoarse. It seemed like he was very sick and shouldn’t have been working at all. The route was very good and passed some great locations but all in all a poor experience when we got no info...
Brilliant possibly the best one to get great commentary in english very helpful staff highly reccomend

I booked this through Trip Advisor, which saved me approx £20 on the pay before you board option. There was a 'live guide' on the bus we boarded at Kudamm, a young Australian man called Chris. He was so good that we did an entire loop without 'hopping off' ...and then on the second time around we disembarked at Checkpoint Charlie and from there walked to the various places we wanted to see before boarding again at the Brandenburg gate. A really good way to see all of the places of interest, with an informative guide!! 10/10

We only had a short stay in Berlin so this bus tour gave us a good overview of the city. We did the red loop which took 2 hours then transferred onto the shorter blue loop, got off at the East Side Gallery and when we had finished there took the U bahn back to the city centre

I researched a number of these tours and this one came out the best for us. A 2 day bus pass with a short boat tour added which worked out really well. The stops are all in good locations, however like all the other tours you cant actually find a stop sign? Just watch out for the buses and look for their staff in the Burgundy tops. It offered 'guided tours' but in all the rides we took we only had one guide, Eric who was excellent. Buses are clean and tidy but the drivers are not bi-lingual. The 1 hour boat ride was good and just enough. We had planned to book another 2.5 hour cruise but glad we did'nt as not sure there was any more to see and it can get cold. One complaint is that we caught the last boat trip but when we then went to get the bus back it had finished for the day and we had to get a taxi right across the city. Why offer a boat trip that you then cant get back from??? Otherwise it was pretty good and the cost was fair for what we got.

We were only in town a couple of days so we wanted an accessible way to get around and learn what to re-visit. Proved very helpful, guide was as advertised and the city is too big to walk across and back in a day so it was a good call. Buses stop running 4.30ish tho so be aware you need to get up early.

Did the 48 hrs hop on/hop off tour & the walking tour & really enjoyed it.Our walking guide was Chris & he was really good company as there was only my wife & I on the walk that morning.He'd a good knowledge about Berlin & I'd highly recommend him

We visited Berlin and bought online tickets for the fantastic "Festival of Lights" by bus (a 2h tour with several stops in between) and for one day hop-on/hop-off. We were pleased by the information shared by the guides on the bus (e.g. the tip for the Museum für Kommunikation), and by the friendly people located at the bus stops. Did I mention already that the app is great? No? It is. :)
And yes, after that we took a 7 euro 1d ticket for bus and metro which is much cheaper, but isn't as informative. The combination worked well for us.

We were in Berlin for a few days so got the 2 days hooper bus tour with walking tour and city of lights bus tour. Hop on hop off was great, most of the time was a English speaking tour guide on the bus otherwise had the ear phones. Did the walking tour with Freddie was absolutely brilliant and would highly recommend very friendly and informative. The city of lights tours had some traffic delays, which we only found out about when we got on the bus but the guide was great and we were really happy with the lights we did see.
Have used big bus before in New York and will be using again, really great service and would recommend

Great tour with live guides on most buses. Also the app is so useful! Definitely recommend as you can see how long you need to wait at each stop. The staff on the ground were very helpful during the protests.

We purchased 3 tickets for the tour and were told that we can hop off to every stop and every 15 minutes there is a bus to hop on again. We were waiting for 40 minutes and called the company and replied that after half an hour the next bus would come to this stop and didn't even care for what happened. I'm not a person who gives negative reviews but it ruined our last day in Berlin because of this. I hope we will manage to get a refund.
What a fantastic tour! Our guide Nanna was both enthusiastic and well informed, thoroughly entertaining, I would highly recommend this to anyone.

Booked the deluxe 48 hour ticket with river cruise and walking tour. On Saturday 21st September we started the tour, but traffic in the the city was at a standstill due to 270,000 people taking part in the climate change protests. The buses could not get to their stops because many of the roads were closed to traffic. At one point we were stranded at the Hauptbahnhof. We met Burak, Bruno and manager Skippy. Skippy took us to the underground station, purchased tickets for us, and accompanied us on the trip back to our hotel. Service above and beyond! Can’t thank him enough. Next day we met Burak and Bruno at Checkpoint Charlie. As our previous day had been disrupted, they extended our tickets by 24 hours, which allowed us time to do the walking tour on Monday. Very helpful, and great ambassadors of the company. We met Nana, a lovely Danish guide, at the Brandenburg Tor. She conducted us on the tour. Very knowledgeable and informative. She’s an absolute star. Can’t recommend this company enough. First class.
Great service from all IHave had to deal with. Live commentary has been a great bonus. Most impressed. Will definitely use in future

I tried 3 weeks ago to contact this company to change ticket as it went through online as the wrong one. No response and we go in a few days. They have no contact number and don't respond to emails. I would go with other companies in future which I know to be reliable £70+ the day ticket cost me too!!!
